expected.name: Solomon Harper
expected.description: Sol Harper, also known as Solomon Harper, was a Black labor organizer, inventor and World War I veteran who had served as a sergeant major in the 349th Field Artillery. He organized with the American Negro Labor Congress and International Labor Defense and belonged to the Workers Ex-Servicemen's League. In 1930, police arrested and assaulted him after he spoke against lynching at a Brotherhood of Sleeping Car Porters meeting in New York City. Rose Kelley was arrested after trying to defend him. Harper faced inciting-to-riot and disorderly-conduct charges and received a three-month jail sentence. He continued campaigning against lynching and for unemployment relief and veterans' benefits. He died in Harlem on December 8, 1980.
